title: Decision contribution vocabulary (proposed under TDR-0049)
description: The machine-readable form of records/decision/specification/decision-contribution.md, which defines every term here. It validates the classification of one fragment's contribution to a consequential decision, and its $defs are the vocabulary itself: the classes, the five canonical reasons something is not a decision, the kinds of evidence that no decision was made, and the roles historical recovery treats specially. Consumers read the vocabulary from here rather than restating it. Not a record schema.

taxonomy_version.description: The version of this vocabulary. Equal to the specification's.

not_a_decision_reason.description: Stable identifiers for the five reasons something resembling a decision is not one.

non_decision_kind.description: Evidence that no decision was made — distinct from no decision being evidenced.

event_role.description: The role a historical candidate's event_time_ref points at.

context_roles.description: Roles graded for contemporaneity and annotated with `considered`.

never_inferred_roles.description: Roles and classes a contribution may fill only with derivation `explicit`: who acted, under what authority, instead of what.
